The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive Voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.

The usage of a "to be" form of verb ["be" in this case] is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.

In Passive Voice, the preposition "by" is used before the object. However, it is optional in some cases.

These types of questions contain Modal verbs. Some of the modal verbs are: Can, could, may, might, shall, should, will, would, must, ought to.

The format of such a sentence in Active Voice is:

Subject + Modal + V1 + Object.

Thus, in Passive voice, the format will be:

Object of the active voice (Subjective case) + Modal + be + V3 + by + Subject of the active voice (Objective case).

For example:

Active: You can do this.

Passive: This can be done by you.

questions.solution:
This is a simple sentence. Even though the subject lists multiple issues (sexual harassment, lack of access to reproductive rights, and gender-based violence), all of them are joined as items within a compound subject, not as separate independent clauses. The predicate is a single unit: are still rampant across the globe. There is no use of a coordinating conjunction (such as and, but, or, so) joining two independent clauses, which rules out the possibility of it being a compound sentence. Similarly, there is no dependent clause introduced by subordinating conjunctions (like because, although, which, that), so it cannot be complex. And since both conditions for a compound-complex sentence (multiple independent clauses plus at least one dependent clause) are absent, that option is also incorrect. The sentence, therefore, consists of only one independent clause with a compound subject and a single predicate, making the correct answer b) Simple.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.question: What type of determiner is the word "these" in the sentence: "However, unlike these past events, which were caused by natural occurrences such as volcanic eruptions or asteroid impacts, the current wave of extinction is primarily the result of human actions"?
questions.questionHtml: What type of determiner is the word "these" in the sentence: "However, unlike these past events, which were caused by natural occurrences such as volcanic eruptions or asteroid impacts, the current wave of extinction is primarily the result of human actions"?
questions.solution:
In the given sentence, the word "these" in "these past events" functions as a demonstrative determiner. Demonstrative determiners are used to point out specific people, things, or events and indicate their relative position in time or space. The word "these" is the plural form of the demonstrative "this" and is used here to specify particular past events being referred to in the context. It distinguishes those specific events (volcanic eruptions or asteroid impacts) from other possible events. It is not a possessive determiner (which would show ownership, e.g., "my," "his"), nor an interrogative determiner (used to ask questions, e.g., "which," "what"), nor an article (like "a," "an," "the"). Therefore, the correct answer is b) Demonstrative determiner.

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.solution:
Subject: The subject of the sentence is "Digital minimalism."

Verb: The main verb connected to the subject is "encourages."

The rest of the sentence, i.e., "individuals to reassess their relationship with devices, streamline apps, and prioritize offline experiences", forms the predicate.

The verbs "reassess," "streamline," and "prioritize" are part of a parallel series of infinitive phrases. They describe what digital minimalism encourages individuals to do. They do not have their own subjects and therefore do not form their own clauses. This is an example of a simple sentence with compound object/predicate elements.

A Simple Sentence consists of one independent clause. An independent clause has one subject-verb pair. This sentence has one subject ("Digital minimalism") and one main verb ("encourages"), so it is a simple sentence. The length or the presence of a list does not change its classification.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

A Compound Sentence has two or more independent clauses. This sentence only has one.

A Complex Sentence has one independent clause and at least one dependent clause. This sentence has no dependent clauses.

A Compound-Complex Sentence has at least two independent clauses and at least one dependent clause.

The control unit is a component of the central processing unit of the computer system that controls the operations of the processor. The functions of CU include:

• Interprets instructions, regulate and control processor timing.

• Sends and receives control signals from other computer gadgets.

• Directs data flow through different components of the CPU.

• Handle tasks such as decoding, fletching, executing the command and storing results.

• Directs sequential data flow.

• Interprets commands and instructions.

An arithmetic logic unit of the CPU performs all processes related to arithmetic and logic operations that need to be done on instruction words. The functions of ALU include:

• Arithmetic Operations: This is basically addition and subtraction. Addition can be substituted for multiplication and subtraction for division.

• Logical Operations: These include NOR, NOT, OR, XOR etc.

• Bit shifting Operations: This entails shifting the position of bits by a certain number of places to either the right or left, which is considered a multiplication operation.
